name: pagination-09
description: Icon-only previous and next links around a plain page indicator for tight toolbars.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, } from "@workspace/ui/components/pagination" const TOTAL = 18 export default function IconOnlyPageIndicator() { const [page, setPage] = React.useState(3) return (
Activity { event.preventDefault() setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1)) }} > Page {page} of {TOTAL} { event.preventDefault() setPage((p) => Math.min(TOTAL, p + 1)) }} >
) }
